extension.description: Standalone Chaturbate Kodi addon with priority-based TV mode, local favorites, and HLS playback through a localhost rewriting proxy.
extension.news: 0.7.17 - "Online: Xh Ym" line now shows in EVERY browse view (Top Cams, New Cams, Female, Male, Couple, Trans, Search), not just Favorites and TV mode like in v0.7.16. v0.7.16 read seconds_online which only the affiliate-onlinerooms endpoint returns; the per-gender /api/ts/roomlist/ endpoint returns start_timestamp (Unix epoch of broadcast start) instead. New _seconds_online_from_room helper unifies both shapes -- prefers server-computed seconds_online, falls back to (now - start_timestamp) when only start_timestamp is present, returns 0 cleanly when neither field is present or start_timestamp is in the future (defensive against clock skew). plot_for accepts an optional now parameter for testability; production callers leave it at None and fall through to time.time(). Pinned with five new regression tests covering both API shapes and the edge cases. 💙 0.7.16 - Two UX polish items. (1) "Online: Xh Ym" line added to the model plot info on the left pane (the same dossier panel that shows Age/Location/Watching/Followers/Tags). Pulled from the affiliate API's seconds_online field which we already fetch but were ignoring. Format: under-1-min omitted (model just started, not useful), under-1-hour shows minutes ("47m"), under-1-day shows hours+minutes ("1h 51m"), at or above 1 day shows days+hours ("3d 14h", minutes drop at that scale). (2) Max resolution settings dropdown was rendering as random network-settings strings ("netmask", "appearance") on Kodi 21+. Root cause: I had <option label="Auto (server-picked)">auto</option> passing literal strings as labels, but Kodi 21+ treats label= as a strings.po ID, fails to resolve, falls back to random core strings. Fixed by switching to bare <option>auto</option> tags (matches the working screensaver_color pattern). Dropdown now shows auto / 1080p / 720p / 480p as plain values. 0.7.15 - URGENT real fix on the dialog-spam I claimed was fixed in v0.7.14 but wasn't. v0.7.14 changed setResolvedUrl to fire IMMEDIATELY with succeeded=False instead of letting Kodi wait 30s and time out. Wrong: setResolvedUrl(False) when the playlist has nothing else to play (solo-slug tier scenario) ALSO fires the "one or more items failed to play" dialog -- and worse, the modal blocks the addon's main thread. Observed today: TV loop went silent for 2h 43m waiting for the user to dismiss. v0.7.15 swaps to setResolvedUrl(handle, True, silent_stub) pointing at a bundled 1-second silent .mp4 (resources/media/silent.mp4, 2784 bytes). Kodi plays it, hits natural end, fires onPlayBackEnded, the loop iterates -- no dialog ever appears, no thread block. PlayerControl(Next) dropped because the natural end-of-stub advances the playlist on its own. Plus heavy diagnostic logging in tv_loop around xbmc.Player().play(), the wait-for-isPlaying loop, the inner monitor loop entry/exit, plus a 60s heartbeat in the inner loop with the current modal dialog id -- so if anything else wedges the main thread we'll see the gap and the dialog state in the log. Test inverted to assert succeeded=True with the silent_stub path and that PlayerControl(Next) is no longer fired. 0.7.14 - URGENT dialog-spam fix on the playvid TV-active-offline path. When TV mode was running a solo-slug tier and the model went offline mid-stream (sessionid expiry / stream end), playvid was firing PlayerControl(Next) and returning WITHOUT calling setResolvedUrl. Kodi sat for 30s waiting for the resolve, then showed "one or more items failed to play" with a sad-face dialog the user had to click OK to dismiss. Each loop iteration spawned another. Fix: still fire PlayerControl(Next) but ALSO call setResolvedUrl(handle, False, _empty_listitem()) so Kodi tears the resolve down cleanly. Two-line code change, regression test inverted to assert exactly one setResolvedUrl call on this path. The intentional Yes/No exit dialog in tv_loop._classify_after_stop is unaffected. 0.7.13 - Sticky-playback enforcement bundle. (1) Restored v0.7.11's working Yes/No dialog (no defaultbutton; v0.7.12's defaultbutton=1 broke focus on Kodi 21 - user couldn't highlight either button). Autoclose defaults to "Keep playing" so accidental walk-away preserves playback. (2) Dropped ALL double-press gestures (double-stop, double-tap-at-end-within-5s) per user directive: "like the double stop and the double next is a no go from now on" / "i never want to remove something that is there to keep it playing forever". classify_stop now ALWAYS returns natural-end on at_end -> rebuild forever. The exit gesture is the dialog (NOT-at-end user stops only) or the "Stop TV mode" menu item. (3) New ``dialog_timeout_seconds`` setting (default 10s, range 5-60) so users tune how fast the dialog auto-resumes after an accidental Stop. (4) New "Settings" menu entry at the bottom of the main menu - opens the addon's settings dialog directly via ``Addon.OpenSettings`` builtin (discoverable from inside the addon, no Kodi-settings-tree drilling). (5) Exit-confirmation notification on every user-driven exit ("TV mode exited" toast for user_stopped/screensaver_dismissed/active_flag_cleared/natural_end paths) so users know the exit took effect. (6) Async old-proxy cleanup (Lesson 34): in-line server.shutdown() blocked playvid for 5+s on stale in-flight requests, tripping Kodi's CPythonInvoker timeout. Cleanup now runs on a daemon thread - playvid returns immediately. Pinned with regression tests across the suite (544 passing). 0.7.12 - Two UX polish fixes on the exit flow: (1) Exit dialog now focuses the "Exit" button by default (defaultbutton=1) so a user who pressed Stop can confirm with a single OK press. Autoclose still defaults to "Keep playing" so accidental ignore preserves sticky-playback. (2) Exit-confirmation notification: every user-driven exit ("user_stopped", "screensaver_dismissed", "active_flag_cleared", "natural_end") now fires a "TV mode exited" notification from the finally block so the user knows the exit took effect. Skips for "aborted" (Kodi shutting down) and "errors_exhausted" (already noisy). "takeover" already had its own notification. 0.7.11 - Replaced the double-stop exit gesture (Lesson 29) with a Yes/No dialog (Lesson 33). User: "ther eis no way to hit stop a second time there is no way to get to stop fast / when nothing is playing stop is gone / i don't know where to even find stop a second time love even with a minute". The double-tap pattern was fundamentally broken when no playback was happening (between iterations / screensaver) because Stop button is unavailable then. Now: on a user-input stop where standard logic would continue, fire ``Dialog().yesno("Exit TV mode?", yeslabel="Exit", nolabel="Keep playing", autoclose=30s)``. Dialog is always reachable from any remote regardless of player state. Default focus on "Keep playing" + 30s autoclose so accidental dismiss preserves sticky-playback. The 5s double-stop force-exit branch is preserved as a fast-path for users who do spam Stop twice quickly. 0.7.10 - URGENT TV-mode resilience fix (Lesson 32). Two compounding bugs: (1) ``Action(Next)`` is the wrong builtin name on Kodi 21+ - logs ``Keymapping error: no such action 'next' defined``. Switched to ``PlayerControl(Next)`` which is the canonical playlist-advance builtin. (2) When playvid resolves offline AND TV mode is active, we now invalidate the bulk-live cache (drop the slug) BEFORE firing the skip. Without this, the loop's next pick_target re-picked the same offline slug for the rest of the poll cycle (~9.5 min default), each iter offline-skipping again, infinite tight loop on a dead model. Bug surfaced when a model went offline mid-stream and user got "Playback failed" with the loop stuck. Pinned with two regression tests. 0.7.9 - Closes two CRITICAL gaps surfaced by the -vs-chaturbatetv coverage audit (docs/-AUDIT.md). (1) start_proxy now auto-stops any previously-tracked proxy before standing up a new one - was leaking daemon threads on every replay because no caller called .stop() on the old handle. New module-level _active_proxy tracker enforces cleanup at the boundary. (2) STOP REINFORCED added to the chunklist exception path - if upstream fails AND state.stopping/terminal is set, fire PlayerControl(Stop) immediately instead of trying cache fallback. Catches the race where reconnect just exhausted but ISA is firing chunklist requests faster than the bg-thread's force-stop reaches Kodi. Lesson 31 captured. 0.7.8 - PlayerControl(Stop) hammer fires from THREE places now (was only one). 's _force_stop is called from: (1) the chunklist handler when terminal-state requests hammer us [0.7.7], (2) the background reconnect thread when retries exhaust [NEW], (3) the watchdog when ISA goes silent after a successful reconnect [NEW]. Without the bg-thread fires, if ISA gave up on its own first, Kodi's player stayed stuck on the last frame with a buffer wheel forever. New module-level _force_player_stop(state) helper shared between all three sites. User audit: "i feel like we didn't bring over all the knowledge and hard fought battles from " - this lands one of the gaps. Lesson 30 documents the pattern. 0.7.7 - URGENT: terminal-chunklist retry loop FINALLY fixed (third attempt). 0.7.3 served empty ENDLIST: ISA "No segments" -> retry. 0.7.4 served HTTP 410: ISA "Download failed" -> retry. ISA respects neither for chunklists. The working pattern ('s, battle-tested for years): serve a finished-VOD playlist body (PLAYLIST-TYPE:VOD + a placeholder #EXTINF + ENDLIST) AND fire ``xbmc.executebuiltin('PlayerControl(Stop)')`` from the handler to tear the player down. Rate-limited to 1/sec so Kodi's event queue doesn't drown if 30+ retries hit in a single second. User: "its hung again love / like before with the buffer wheel" - same shape, different code path, same root cause. 0.7.6 - TV mode list now actually shows highest-priority on top. User: "the shorting on tv is in reverse like the lows are at the top and highs at the bottom love is that by design" - it was not. Our priority_sort produced a correct descending list, but Kodi alpha-sorted the labels by default (the [P##] prefix made [P01] sort above [P17] alphabetically/numerically). Fix: pass unsorted=True to end_directory which adds SORT_METHOD_UNSORTED so Kodi keeps our insertion order. Pinned with regression test. 0.7.5 - Discoverable double-stop exit (Lesson 29). User can't easily exit TV mode via the player's Stop button when conditions don't fit the Lesson-17 disambiguator (model went offline, idle high, etc) - by design (we want playback persistence). Now when the user hits Stop and we'd normally continue: show a 5-second notification "Hit Stop again within 5s to exit TV mode" and arm a follow-up trigger. Second Stop within the window = force exit, bypassing the disambiguator. Outside the window = resets to first-stop behavior. Existing Lesson-17 ISA-misfire guard preserved (model_live check stays - keep playback sticky in normal cases). 0.7.4 - URGENT: chunklist terminal/no-cache paths return HTTP 410 instead of empty ENDLIST body. Empty ENDLIST manifest had no segments, so ISA logged "ParseChildManifest: No segments in the manifest" and re-fetched immediately, producing a 100+ req/sec tight retry loop on = the long-spinning buffer wheel. 410 matches the segment terminal-path behavior and tells ISA "permanently gone, stop retrying." Two regression tests pin the new contract for terminal flag and no-cache fallback paths. 0.7.3 - URGENT: TV mode now falls back to per-slug AJAX when the affiliate-onlinerooms endpoint times out on cold start. Real-world scenario tonight: chaturbate's affiliate API slowed to 30s+ timeouts, TV mode dead-started with no cached slugs. Without a fallback, every is_live call returned False and pick_target found no live targets. With the fallback, when bulk fails AND cache is empty, we hit cb_client.is_model_live(slug) per-query for THIS call only; subsequent calls retry bulk first so we recover automatically when the affiliate endpoint comes back. Pinned with regression test. 0.7.2 - TV mode list rows finally carry the state-aware ctxmenu (Edit TV Priority + Remove from TV + Add to / Remove from Favorites). Regression from - previous tv_list rendering passed nothing to ctx_items so right-clicking a TV entry showed an empty menu. Pinned with regression test. 0.7.1 - refresh_artwork now walks every Textures*.db it finds (Kodi 21+ bumped to Textures14.db; older addons targeted Textures13.db only). Forward-compat for whatever schema bump comes next. Tolerates schema-mismatched DBs gracefully (skip with log, don't crash). Added regression tests for both the dual-DB walk and the schema-mismatch skip path. 0.7.0 - Tier-Next button no longer stops TV mode (real bug, not by design): clicking Next in the player to switch between live tier members was firing TAKEOVER because the queued plugin URLs got resolved to localhost proxy URLs before onAVStarted saw them, so the "is this in our queue?" check always failed. Fixed with a playlist-coherence fallback: if path is 127.0.0.1 AND playlist size matches queued count AND position is valid, treat as internal advance. User direct-play (which replaces the playlist) still fires takeover correctly. Plus three new features: max_resolution setting (auto / 1080p / 720p / 480p) caps ISA's variant pick to reduce buffering on slow edges. Two new menu items at the bottom of the main menu: "Refresh artwork" clears Kodi's Textures13.db cache for the addon (icon/fanart never auto-refresh after an update); "Restart Kodi" runs Quit (LibreELEC respawns) to clear stuck audio renderer state without ssh. 0.6.9 - TV mode now uses the same single-call affiliate-onlinerooms endpoint as Online Favorites for live-set detection. Was doing 60 sequential per-slug AJAX calls per poll cycle; now 1 affiliate fetch with TTL aligned to poll_minutes. Network failure keeps the stale slug set so a transient 5xx doesn't mark every model offline. Plus: hls_proxy startup race fixed (refresh/trigger callback closures now populated BEFORE thread.start() instead of after - a request landing in the gap was calling None()). Pure-store modules (tv_store, favs_store) now log load/save events. fav_add and fav_remove get entry/exit log lines. Stale docstrings in cb_client and cb_resolve updated. New tests/test_color_regression.py walks every emitted [COLOR] tag and pins Lesson 4 (8-char AARRGGBB only). Four new lessons added to docs/LESSONS-LEARNED.md (21-24). 0.6.8 - Browse views now client-side sort by viewers descending. The room-list API returns rooms in mixed order (top ~8 high-traffic then a roughly random tail) - same behavior has, neither addon was sorting. Top Cams / Female / Male / Couple / Trans / Search now show most-watched on top, walking down. New Cams left alone (recently-online ordering is the point). Plus: per-gender toggles in settings (Show Female / Show Male / Show Couple / Show Trans, all default on). Toggle off any category you don't want cluttering the main menu. Favorites and TV mode lists are NOT filtered by these toggles - those are personal collections you picked yourself. 0.6.7 - URGENT: dropped the on-disk bulk-fetch cache. Versions 0.6.3 - 0.6.6 cached the slug set (only) on disk for 30 minutes; on a disk-cache hit the online favs rendered WITHOUT thumbnails or plot info because the model-rich data was in-memory only. Now memory-only cache (30s TTL); each Online Favorites entry past the TTL does a fresh single-call affiliate fetch which is sub-second anyway. Legacy ``bulk_live_cache.json`` files get cleaned up on first call. Online favs render with thumbnails + viewer counts + plot info on every fresh fetch. 0.6.6 - Switched bulk-fetch to chaturbate's single-call affiliate-onlinerooms endpoint ('s pattern). Was walking 50 pages of /api/ts/roomlist/ at 100/page (5-10s); now does ONE GET to /affiliates/api/onlinerooms/?format=json&wm=XXX which returns ALL online rooms in a single ~7MB response. Same coverage, sub-second response. In-memory cache TTL dropped from 5min to 60s since each fresh fetch is now fast. Watermark rotates from 's array (matches the user's pre-existing affiliate distribution). Plus new cb_listing.parse_affiliate_onlinerooms parser since field shape differs (username/image_url/room_subject vs slug/img/subject). 0.6.5 - Online favorites now render with thumbnails, viewer count, and plot info on the left (matching the browse views) - the bulk room-list fetch already had the live-model data, we just weren't propagating it to the ListItem. Offline favorites stay as bare entries by design (we deliberately don't poll 1000+ slugs to get stale metadata; offline rooms have no live data to show anyway). Plus: docs sweep - LESSONS-LEARNED gets six new entries (15 API limit drift, 16 top-level menu network ban, 17 paginated rendering, 18 busy-dialog dismiss, 19 hot-path log noise, 20 long-running plugin invocation spinner). README + PLANNING current-state blocks updated. 0.6.4 - URGENT API contract fix: chaturbate's room-list API now caps limit at 100 (was 500); every bulk fetch was getting HTTP 400 'Bad Request' and Online Favorites showed empty even with live models in the user's list. Lowered _BULK_PAGE_LIMIT to 100, raised _BULK_MAX_PAGES to 50 to keep coverage at ~5000 rooms. Pinned with regression test. Plus: dismiss any lingering Kodi busy dialog at TV mode + favs entry points ('s pattern - prevents the "stuck spinner over playing video" UX after a previous slow invocation). 0.6.3 - URGENT favorites fix: 1224-fav library locked up the UI on . Top-level Favorites menu no longer triggers a network call (just shows Online/Offline drill-downs); bulk room-list fetch is deferred to category open. Online/Offline views paginate at 50 entries per page so the directory render doesn't choke on 1000+ rows. Bulk-fetch now has a politeness pacer between page calls AND a 30-min on-disk cache so re-entering Favorites after a Kodi restart is instant. Per-segment / per-chunklist hls_proxy "OK" log lines dropped (1+/sec was flooding the feature log during steady-state playback); errors and reconnects still log. 0.6.2 - QA HIGH bundle: HLS proxy now rewrites EXT-X-RENDITION-REPORT URI in chunklist bodies (LL-HLS quality-switch fetches were going direct to chaturbate edges and getting 403'd). chaturbatetv_active literal centralized in tv_state.ACTIVE_KEY (was duplicated across tv_loop, addon_actions). TV playlist URLs now derive slug from TVEntry.url instead of using the display name (broke playback for any user-customized name; ``Alice the Cam Star`` was being passed where ``alice`` belonged). Migration tool no longer crashes when source favorites.db lacks the expected schema (table missing, wrong columns, etc). 0.6.1 - QA fix bundle: Search row routes to mode=search_prompt (was a dead route to the renderer that closes on empty query). TV-mode offline auto-skip lands (Lesson v6.1) - when the active TV playlist hits an offline slug, fire Action(Next) so the player advances instead of sitting on a black screen. Settings.xml entries finally read in production: poll_minutes (TV loop interval), isa_proxy_port (fixed-port option for locked-down LANs), screensaver_color (cyan / green / hotpink). New addon_settings module centralizes the read+clamp+default behavior. 0.6.0 - Phase 5: TV mode lands. _TVPlayer subclass with state-reset between iterations (Lesson 10), file-switch takeover detection (Lesson 11), idle-time disambiguator at the stop site (Lesson 17), random-tier pick (Lesson 14). Idle screensaver via xbmcgui.Window (NOT WindowDialog - Lesson 20) with HALO cyan bouncing label, periodic re-walk every 60s. tv_play / tv_stop / tv_list / tv_add / tv_remove / tv_edit verbs all wired through tv_store. Browse + favs rows now show a state-aware right-click menu (Add to TV vs In TV / Edit / Remove; Add to Favorites vs Remove from Favorites). Verbose logging gated on enh_debug across the new modules. 0.5.0 - Phase 4c: HLS proxy hardened with the eleven PR #1818 lessons. Chunklists and segments now route through 127.0.0.1 so ISA always uses our headers (was 403ing direct CDN hits). Gzip-aware fetcher, three-tier segment fallback, cached playlists during reconnect, lock-protected reconnect guard, watchdog after a successful refresh, terminal-flag fast-path (ENDLIST chunklists / 410 segments) so ISA tears down cleanly. Verbose logging gated on enh_debug across cb_client, cb_resolve, cb_listing, browse_views, favs_views, router, tv_state, hls_proxy. Bonus: favs menu now bulk-fetches the live room-list once instead of polling every favorite (~5s vs 4 minutes for 1224 favs, Lesson 11). 0.4.3 - Fix Cannot download manifest: cb_resolve switched to AJAX endpoint (reliable JSON) instead of the fragile HTML dossier scrape. Strip hashtag duplicates from the subject line (tag-line at the bottom already shows them in green). Light gated logging on the playvid path (logger._log -> chaturbatetv_feature.log when enh_debug=true). 0.4.2 - Phase 4b: playvid resolver + ISA props (Matrix+ inputstream key, manifest_type=hls, stream/manifest headers urlencoded, MIME hint, contentLookup=False); addon_actions.playvid wired through setResolvedUrl with offline notification. Browse + favs views now declare content-type=videos so InfoWall / MediaList view modes are available (thumbnail on the right, plot on the left). 0.4.1 - QA-driven polish: model thumbnails (real img URL not hardcoded), hover plot info (Age / Location / Watching / Followers / Tags), favs labels render (8-char hex), favs Online/Offline drill-down works (was a router gap). 0.4.0 - Phase 4a: localhost HLS rewriting proxy (MVP). Master playlist absolutize+rewrite, iPad UA + Referer header injection, dynamic 127.0.0.1 port. Stream playback hookup lands in 0.4.1. 0.3.1 - Fix [COLOR] tags: Kodi requires 8-char AARRGGBB hex; bare 6-char rendered Female/Male/Couple/Trans labels and model names blank. 0.3.0 - Switch browse to Chaturbates JSON API (room-list endpoint). Drops HTML scraping entirely. 0.2.1 - Polish: full-bleed fanart, provider-name fix. 0.2.0 - Phase 2: browse menus (Top, New, Female, Male, Couple, Trans, Search), local favorites, migration tool.
